ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The gray tile on the left in the figure is a “T” shape composed of 4 unit squares: there are 3 squares arranged in a row on top, and below, 1 square is connected directly under the middle square. On the right is a 4×5 grid board, with a total of 20 unit squares. Reasoning: Each T-shaped tile occupies 4 unit squares, so if 5 can be placed, they would exactly cover all 20 squares. Now color the 4×5 grid board black and white in a checkerboard manner. Since there are 20 squares in total, there are 10 black squares and 10 white squares. A T tetromino placed in any direction will cover 3 squares of the same color and 1 square of the other color, so each T-shaped tile causes a difference of 2 between the numbers of black and white squares. If 5 T shapes are placed and cover the whole board, then adding together the contributions of 5 differences of 2 cannot obtain a black-white quantity difference of 0, so 5 cannot be placed. Therefore the maximum can only be 4. It is still necessary to explain that 4 can be done: take a 4×4 region in the 4×5 grid board, leaving the 5th column unused. Four T shapes can be placed: the first occupies row 1 columns 1 to 3, with the stem at row 2 column 2; the second, after rotation, occupies column 4 rows 1 to 3, with the stem at row 2 column 3; the third, after rotation, occupies column 1 rows 2 to 4, with the stem at row 3 column 2; the fourth, after being inverted, occupies row 4 columns 2 to 4, with the stem at row 3 column 3. These four T shapes do not overlap with one another. Therefore the maximum number is 4.

raw_record.question_text: What is the largest number of "T"-shaped pieces, as shown, that can be placed on the 4 × 5 grid in the diagram, without any overlap of the pieces?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the piece is a T-tetromino made of 4 unit squares, with three squares in a row and one square attached to the middle; the board is a 4-by-5 grid of 20 unit squares. To get an upper bound, color the 4-by-5 grid like a chessboard. The grid has 10 black and 10 white squares. Any T-tetromino, in any rotation, covers 3 squares of one color and 1 square of the other, so each piece creates a color imbalance of 2. If 5 pieces were placed, they would cover all 20 squares, but the sum of five imbalances of size 2 cannot be zero, so the equal black-white board cannot be tiled by 5 T pieces. Thus at most 4 pieces fit. Then show 4 are achievable by placing four T pieces in a 4-by-4 block inside the 4-by-5 grid, leaving the fifth column empty: one T across row 1 columns 1–3 with its stem at row 2 column 2; one rotated T using column 4 rows 1–3 with its stem at row 2 column 3; one rotated T using column 1 rows 2–4 with its stem at row 3 column 2; and one upside-down T across row 4 columns 2–4 with its stem at row 3 column 3. Therefore the maximum is 4.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左边的灰色拼块是由4个单位正方形组成的“T”形：上面有3个正方形排成一行，下面在中间正方形的正下方连着1个正方形。右边是一个4×5的方格板，共有20个单位正方形。

推理：每个T形拼块占4个单位正方形，所以若能放5个，就会刚好覆盖全部20个方格。现在把4×5方格板按棋盘方式黑白染色，因为共有20格，所以黑格10个、白格10个。任意方向放置的T形四连块都会覆盖3个同色格和1个另一色格，因此每个T形拼块造成黑白数量差为2。若放5个T形并覆盖全板，则5个差值为2的贡献相加不可能得到黑白数量差0，所以5个不可能放下。因此最多只能是4个。

还需要说明4个可以做到：在4×5方格板中取一个4×4区域，留下第5列不用。可放置四个T形：第一个占第1行第1至3列，茎在第2行第2列；第二个旋转后占第4列第1至3行，茎在第2行第3列；第三个旋转后占第1列第2至4行，茎在第3行第2列；第四个倒置后占第4行第2至4列，茎在第3行第3列。这四个T形互不重叠。因此最大数量是4。
